## Tailwind CSS LSP 
 - Completion, diagnostics, hover, formatting and IntelliSense for Tailwind CSS classes
 - Shows the Tailwind logo inline next to every detected Tailwind utility class in class="..."
 - The class list is built from the project's node_modules/tailwindcss theme (or the installed language server), so it follows the Tailwind version
 - Supports variant prefixes (md:, hover:), negative values, opacity modifiers and arbitrary values
 - Works with HTML, JSX, TSX, Vue, Svelte and other template files
